Open light timber canopy projects to the left; curving descending road and valley behind establish an approximate front interpretation. Rear depth and post inventory are hidden.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Complete exterior interpretation of the mapped smithy/carpentry range at Yasnaya Polyana: gray log workshop on a low red-brick plinth, broad weathered-board hip roof, single red-brick chimney, recessed warm wooden double door beneath a shallow supported hood, and a genuinely open timber-post lean-to alongside the room. Original map outline anchors the complete envelope; the long rear extent is map-led and hidden in the front photographs. All canopy and hood supports remain present in every LOD. No invented forge interior, machinery, merchandise, copied signs, inscriptions, artwork, people or photograph pixels. Hidden rear doors/windows and exact historical roof/support inventory remain approximate.
